title: Chapter 331: Strange Origin
content:
Chapter 331: Strange Origin

In this world, no army of any race can defeat the combined army of the Zerg and the Protoss, not even the Snow Demon Clan.

After two days and two nights of fighting, the Snow Demon Clan's army's losses were incalculable.

After exhausting all means, the Snow Demon Clan finally decided to take a risk with its strong men.

The Tianwai people have seen the power of the Zerg strong men, and they have even lost a powerful figure. The Snow Demon Clan is well aware of these situations.

The Snow Demon Clan's army is now unable to fight and cannot retreat. The situation is very embarrassing. They can only break the rules first and let a large number of strong men attack.

Little did they know that Wu Qing was waiting for their strong men to take action.

The Snow Demon Clan has a deep foundation, and there are many strong men accompanying the army. In addition to a large number of seven-star snow demons, eight-star snow demons are also common, and nine-star snow demons have come to the front line.

As soon as these Snow Demon Clan warriors decided to attack, the already extremely powerful natural disaster-level ice magic was instantly strengthened several times, which caught the Zerg and Protoss army off guard.

But the terrible counterattack of the Zerg and Protoss army made the Snow Demon Clan regret letting the strong men attack.

The seven-star Protoss senior templar warriors, who had been ready for a long time, cast ion storms at the area where the Snow Demon Clan army was located, and suddenly all the ion energy in the entire area was exploded.

All the areas where the Snow Demon Clan army was located were caught in the boundless lightning storm. No matter how many stars the Snow Demon Clan soldiers were, they disappeared under such a powerful attack.

The main firepower output arms of the Zerg and Protoss army stopped attacking. They no longer had to attack the enemies covered by the ion storm.

The seven-star strongmen of the Snow Demon Clan could not hold on under the attack of the ion storm, not to mention other arms with weaker strength.

Since he had already started, Wu Qing had no worries about the mission.

The six-star Zerg Scorpion, the six-star Zerg Queen, the seven-star Zerg Scorpion and the seven-star Zerg Queen attacked all the seven-star and eight-star Snow Demon Clan warriors who were exposed. Their one-hit-kill ability was still the best way to kill the strong.

The Arbitrator controlled by the eight-star Light Archon used his summoning ability to summon the Protoss Arbitration Court warriors who were on missions in various places.

A large number of seven-star Protoss Berserkers and seven-star Protoss Dark Templars killed the Snow Demon Clan warriors.

The eight-star Protoss Light Archon and the eight-star Protoss Dark Archon followed closely behind, using their powerful combat power and skills to eliminate the Snow Demon Clan warriors.

The attack of the Light Archon was simple and effective. Each of their attacks had extremely powerful lethality. Enemies of the same level were almost all killed with one hit.

The seven-star Snow Demon Clan warriors could not even withstand the aftermath of the spiritual power of the Light Archon's attack. They were either dead or injured at a long distance.

Every time the eight-star light archon attacked, a large number of Snow Demon tribe warriors fell.

The eight-star dark archons had another style of attack. They had almost no attack power and mainly used skills to attack.

A feedback skill, the Snow Demon tribe warriors who mainly cast spells, no matter what star strength they were, were killed in one blow.

A mental control skill, a group of Snow Demon tribe warriors were forcibly controlled, and turned around to launch a fierce attack on their former compatriots.

A large vortex skill, a large number of Snow Demon tribe warriors were directly fixed and became targets for slaughter.

Coupled with the powerful seven-star Protoss Berserker and the elusive seven-star Protoss Dark Templar, a large number of Snow Demon tribe warriors were basically wiped out by a combination of Zerg and Protoss without making any moves.

The remaining Snow Demon tribe army was all handed over to the seven-star Protoss senior Templar. Their ion storms came one after another, and no matter how many troops there were, they could not withstand this kind of world-destroying continuous attack.

When those powerful nine-star snow demons were killed by the eight-star light archons and the eight-star dark archons of the Protoss, the outcome of this battle was no longer in doubt.

The powerful snow demons did not make a move for some reason.

On the snowy battlefield, the ion storm that lasted for a long time finally ended, and the natural disaster-level ice magic had long disappeared.

The originally aggressive snow beast tide had also retreated.

The entire snowy field has returned to its former tranquility.

If it weren't for the broken ice on the battlefield, it would be impossible to tell how terrible a battle had just taken place here.

...

After the Snow Demon Clan was defeated in one battle, it never organized a large army to attack the joint base of the Zerg and Protoss.

Instead, Wu Qing let go and let the seven-star and above Zerg and Protoss strongmen take the transport-type Zerg hosts and Protoss transport planes to attack the main gathering places of the Snow Demon Clan in the northern war zone.

No life can escape the ion storm of the Protoss High Templar.

As long as the strong men of the Snow Demon Clan are discovered by the reconnaissance troops of the Zerg and Protoss, they will be killed by the powerful troops of the Zerg and Protoss.

Under such a strong attack from the Zerg and Protoss, the Snow Demon Clan had to shrink its range of activities and gave a large area of the northern war zone to the Zerg and Protoss.

The entire northern war zone is large enough, and it will take a lot of time for the Zerg and Protoss to actually control it.

The Snow Demon Clan is trading space for time, hoping to find a way to deal with the Zerg and Protoss.

Wu Qing sent a large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to open up the passage from the Zerg and Protoss joint base to the control area of the local race camp. The Zerg, the leader of the northern war zone, finally contacted other races.

It was not until this time that the various forces of the local race camp discovered that the Zerg had already established a foothold in the hinterland of the northern war zone.

As the overlord of the northern war zone, the Snow Demon Clan and other creatures living on the snowfield immediately retreated when they saw the Zerg army, like a frightened bird.

The situation in the northern war zone has stabilized. As long as the Zerg and Protoss joint army implements the expansion plan step by step and eats away the Snow Demon Clan's territory step by step, it will not take long for the entire northern war zone to become the world of the Zerg and Protoss joint army.

…

Once the Snow Demon Clan was defeated, the aliens, demons, and bear goblins could no longer hold on. The Zerg army quickly occupied the public battlefield of the southern theater and completely drove out the aliens.

The Zerg did not monopolize the public battlefield of the southern theater. Wu Qing allowed other native races to continue to recuperate here.

A far-reaching public battlefield became a place for the native race camp to recuperate because of the arrival of the Zerg.

There was no war to fight here, and the various races transferred a large number of elite troops deployed here to other battlefields.

The Zerg army was of course even more restless, and the main combat forces were all transferred to other battlefields.

In the sphere of influence of the evil god camp, the demons and bear goblins were beaten back by the Zerg army and gave up a large amount of territory.

The Zerg has developed to this point, and the evil god camp has little power to stop the attack of the Zerg army.

After the Zerg gained the status of a large clan, Wu Qing began to launch a full-scale counterattack against the evil god camp.

A large number of Zerg air forces fought their way up from south to north along the main battle line of the camp war. Any organized evil god camp army encountered on the way was attacked by the Zerg air forces.

With the Zerg's leadership, the various races in the local camp began to cooperate with the Zerg army's actions and launched a counterattack against the evil god camp.

This is a rare sight in many years. The local camp has been suppressed by the evil god camp for too long.

The Zerg army is getting bigger and bigger. As the Zerg's sub-bases are blooming all over the world, the Zerg army can be seen almost everywhere in the world where there is war.

The reputation of the Zerg is already in full swing.

…

Wu Qing spent a lot of time sorting out the camp war. Next, he will enter the mezzanine world, where the main combat power of each large clan and super clan is located.

Since he is going to start solving the weird problems, Wu Qing will also go to the weirdness of the area where the Zerg base camp is located.

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the body, and he first upgraded the Zerg mother nest to nine stars.

In the battle with the Snow Demon Clan, the Zerg and Protoss combined forces had killed enough nine-star enemies, and the Zerg hive could have been upgraded long ago.

However, at this stage of development, it doesn’t matter whether the Zerg hive is upgraded or not.

After upgrading to a nine-star Zerg hive, there will be no restrictions in the future.

Wu Qing upgraded all Zerg buildings for the last time, which raised the strength of the Zerg army to a small level.

The Protoss base was not restricted by the system, and all upgrade options had been upgraded, and nine-star Protoss troops could be directly materialized.

Wu Qing hatched and materialized some nine-star troops.

Wu Qing’s body, with the nine-star troops of the Zerg and Protoss, boarded a huge nine-star Protoss transport spaceship and flew to the endless mountains next to it.

The nine-star Protoss transport spaceship flew out of the Zerg territory and stopped.

Wu Qing’s body once again walked out of the lord’s protection range.

When Wu Qing and the Zerg had just landed, there was an extremely terrifying weird that had been pestering him and had launched many attacks on the Zerg base.

Wu Qing wanted to see which weird dared to come out now and what relationship it had with the weird lord of the Endless Mountains.

It was night time at this time, and Wu Qing's ten-star powerful spiritual power could see everything in the surrounding area clearly.

Those various weirds projected from the interlayer world space, sensing Wu Qing's breath, did not dare to come over at all.

"Hehehe...!"

As expected, Wu Qing was not disappointed. The weird that had tampered with Wu Qing's body arrived as expected.

It was a very powerful spiritual power, not evil, nor bright, like a wandering elf in the world, doing things it thought were interesting in its own way.

This was the information that Wu Qing perceived through the powerful spiritual power.

Wu Qing's recovered power was very powerful now, and he had no shortage of various powerful spiritual power methods.

As soon as he thought about it, the sky and the earth changed color, and the entire nearby area became Wu Qing's domain space. He took control of everything.

In this world, Wu Qing can already use many abilities that exceed his own strength.

"Wow wow wow...!"

The powerful weird was caught by Wu Qing and immediately became anxious. It was not until this moment that it realized that it had provoked an existence that it could not afford to provoke.

As long as Wu Qing is willing, he can forcefully invade the weird spiritual consciousness and read the information recorded in it.

He can also erase the spiritual will of this spiritual power and turn it into a pure spiritual power in a moment.

He can even shatter this spiritual power completely, turning it into the energy of heaven and earth and disappearing forever.

"Respected Lord! Please show mercy and leave a way out for my naughty child!"

At this moment, a terrifying spiritual power descended and conveyed a message to Wu Qing.

The existence that Wu Qing was waiting for finally appeared.

"The weird lord of the Endless Mountains?"

Wu Qing was not polite. These powerful weirds were not kind people. One thought would kill hundreds of millions of lives.

"You can call me that!"

The weird lord of the Endless Mountains seemed easy to talk to.

Wu Qing could feel that the strength of the strange lord of the Endless Mountains was stronger than him, at least an eleven-star strongman, enough to be compared with some evil gods.

This is an extremely powerful existence in this world, no wonder the place where it is located has become a taboo place.

"Letting go of your child, of course there is no problem, we are just playing a little game."

"However, it has damaged some of my things, I hope you can compensate me!"

The Queen of Insects beside Wu Qing was not afraid of the strange lord of the Endless Mountains at all. Even with his own strength, he was enough to fight against the strange lord of the Endless Mountains.

The strange lord of the Endless Mountains seemed to be aware of this situation and was not angry at all.

"Then I will give you a message!"

"We are not the enemies of this world, we are also victims of the invasion of foreign forces!"

"According to my long-term research, it seems that a terrible unknown force has eroded this world. This world has separated part of its power and that terrible unknown force, and finally formed our strange species."

"So, we are also part of this world, especially the strange like us who have independent wisdom, which can be regarded as getting rid of the control of that unknown force and becoming a complete native creature!"

"If you want to help this world, you have to enter the interlayer world and eliminate that terrible unknown force!"

"It's useless to fight like those people now."

The strange lord of the Endless Mountains said a piece of news that surprised Wu Qing.
